home.title: Home
home.heading: Scientific conference
home.lead: Call for papers, programme and registration.

fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters, not a common password.

login.title: Sign in
login.verificationPending: Your address is not verified yet. A new verification link has just been sent to you (at most one every three minutes): check your inbox.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.lead: One account to submit, review, register and take part.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.sent: Check your inbox: a verification link has been sent to you.
verify.sentTo: Check your inbox: if the address {{email}} can be used, an email has just been sent to it.
verify.verified: Your address is verified. You can now sign in.
verify.resendHint: Nothing received? Check your spam folder, then sign in: a new link will be sent to you.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your account address: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account matches this address, an email will be sent to you within the next few minutes. The link is valid for two hours.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in.

home.title: My account
home.noticeLead: Before continuing, please read how your data is processed.
home.profileLead: First name, last name, institution and country are required to submit a paper.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: This information is used for submissions, reviews and registrations.
profile.languageLead: The language chosen with the selector at the top of the page is saved in your account: it is also used for emails.

notice.summary: Privacy notice on your data (provisional version)
notice.controller: Data controller: the conference organizing committee. The final text, compliant with the applicable legal framework, will replace this provisional version before the call for papers opens.
notice.purpose: Your data (email address, profile, roles) is used only to manage your participation: accounts, submissions, reviews, programme and registrations.
notice.retention: Sign-ins and sensitive actions are logged for security; the IP address is erased after six months.
notice.rights: You may export your data or request the anonymization of your account from your account area at any time.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.stepUpLead: To access the management area, confirm your identity with the code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).

reauth.title: Confirm your identity
reauth.lead: This is a sensitive operation: confirm your password to continue.
reauth.useCode: Use a two-factor authentication code instead

security.title: Security
security.mfaEnabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled on your account.
security.mfaDisabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled on your account.
security.mfaRequiredHint: It is mandatory for management roles: administration, chairs, organising and scientific committees.
security.scanLead: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (FreeOTP, Aegis, Google Authenticator…), then enter the code it shows.
security.activated: Two-factor authentication enabled. Write down your recovery codes below.
security.stepUpNeeded: To access management during this session, confirm your code once.
security.recoveryLead: Each one can be used only once. Keep them somewhere safe: they let you sign in if you lose your phone.
security.regenerated: New codes generated: the old ones are no longer valid.
security.disableWarning: Without two-factor authentication, the management area will be refused.
security.resendTooSoon: A link was sent less than three minutes ago: try again a little later.
security.added: Address added: a verification link has been sent to it.
